description:
Get a high-impact color and long-lasting effect with Crazy Color

The Crazy Color Semi-Permanent Renbow Collection comes in 41 vibrant shades and 5 pastel hues. Using this semi-permanent hair dye you get a vibrant color that lasts for 6-8 washes. Our renbow collection is 100% vegan and cruelty-free. All colors are mixable so you can create your custom color. For optimal results apply the dye to pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.

If you care about ethical choices, Crazy Color does too:
Cruelty-free: None of our products have been tested on animals.
Vegan friendly: Our products are free from animal-derived ingredients.

How to use:

  1. Do a patch test. Rule out the possibility of an allergy and make sure you’re happy with the color.
  2. Lighten your hair: For the most vibrant results, use crazy color on pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.
  3. Wash your hair with a PH balanced shampoo. Don't condition your hair.
  4. Apply Crazy Colour dye to your wet hair with a tint brush. Brush the dye from the top of your scalp to the nape of your neck and along each strand of hair. Comb it to make sure it’s evenly coated.
  5. Leave the dye on for 15 - 30 minutes. You can wrap your hair in plastic to keep it warm. Keep it in longer if your hair is thick and resistant to coloring.
  6. Rinse your hair with cool water until the water runs clear.

You did it!

Semi-permanent dyes will lose color intensity after each wash.
Retain your color brightness with these tips.

  • Wash hair with cold water.
  • Shampoo as little as possible.
  • Don’t sunbathe.
  • Avoid swimming.
  • Refrain from High Heat Styling.

    Additional Tips:

    • Use gloves when handling the color cream.
    • Keep the hair color vibrant by adding a drop to your conditioner.
    • Sleep on dark-colored pillows because the color can rub off a bit.

What you get:
1 Crazy Color bottle of 150ML (5 oz)

Balancing the pH level is vital in producing ideal results from a color process. Too much acidity causes the hair to be oily and for the hair shaft to close, making it difficult for color to effectively deposit. Too much alkaline causes the hair to become very dry because the hair shaft becomes very open. A balanced pH level allows for the hair shaft to be open just enough to effectively deposit the color without drying out the hair. AMMONIA Minimal levels (1.8% – 3.5%) of this essential hair color ingredient slightly increases the alkalinity of the formula, ensuring that the hair shaft is sufficiently open to allow the color to fully deposit. - Grab a hair chalk, a towel or a plastic cape, gloves, a hair clip, hair spray and trigger bottle with water (or just tap water)
- slightly wet your hair and the end of the hair chalk

description:

This new temporary hair wax adds texture and shine, suitable for all hair types from medium to thick hair.

Temporary (one-day) coloring

A good solution for people who like trying new colors. Our product is loved by parents who want to give their kids a temporary color for parties or special occasions or just for fun.

How to use

1. Place a finger full of wax on your palm and spread evenly.

2. Apply to all areas that need a color boost

3. Slay with your new look

4. Washes out easily after each use.

How to choose your colors

Red/Brown/Dark Hair: We recommend Purple, Blue, Gold and Silver colors. The Red color looks like a subdued pink shade on dark hair.

Blonde/Bleached Hair: All colors look great. Silver won't be prominent on bleached hair though.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Does this dry out?

A: Yes - after you apply the Color Wax on your hair, it dries out pretty quickly.

Q: What happens in the rain?

A: While we don't recommend you stay out in heavy rain with or without the hair wax (you know, cause you might catch a cold) - the Color Wax doesn't come off in a mild drizzle. But if you're in the rain long enough - that's pretty much like taking a shower and it will come off.

Q: Does this work on dark hair?

A: The color effect is much more pronounced on lighter hair - and yes, the Color Wax does work on bleached hair as well. The color effect on dark hair is subdued and subtle - but still pretty great.

Q: Will this damage my hair?

A: Based on hundreds of customers' feedback who use the Color Wax several days of the week, combined with the fact that its made out of plant extracts - this will not damage your hair.

Q: Is this safe for kids?

A: Absolutely! In fact, many of our customers buy the Color Wax especially for their kids.

Garnier Nutrisse Ultra Color Nourishing Hair Color Creme comes with an ampoule of grapeseed oil to start nourishing hair while you color because nourished hair means better color. Store between 50° and 80° F. Questions? Garnier Nutrisse has expert color consultants to help you. Call: 1-800-4GARNIER (1-800-442-7643). IMPORTANT: Hair color can cause an allergic reaction. Do not use if you’ve already had a reaction to a hair color product or if scalp is sensitive, itchy or damaged. Tattoos may increase risk of an allergic reaction. Don’t use on children. This is a safety summary. Read all labeling and instructions completely.

description:

The Crazy Color Semi-Permanent Renbow Collection comes in 41 vibrant shades and 5 pastel hues. Using this semi-permanent hair dye you get a vibrant color that lasts for 6-8 washes. If you care about ethical choices, Crazy Color does too:
Cruelty-free: None of our products have been tested on animals.
Vegan friendly: Our products are free from animal-derived ingredients.

How to use:

  1. Do a patch test. Rule out the possibility of an allergy and make sure you’re happy with the color.
  2. Lighten your hair: For the most vibrant results, use crazy color on pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.
  3. Wash your hair with a PH balanced shampoo. Don't condition your hair.
  4. Apply Crazy Colour dye to your wet hair with a tint brush. Brush the dye from the top of your scalp to the nape of your neck and along each strand of hair. Comb it to make sure it’s evenly coated.

Semi-permanent dyes will lose color intensity after each wash.
Retain your color brightness with these tips.

  • Don’t sunbathe.

Pudding can do more than what you believe! Now, easy and clear coloring is possible with this groundbreaking, innovative method! Color effortlessly with this hard-to-find pudding-like gel cream by Korean brand EZN that offers vivid coloring + sheen by delivering hydrolyzed silk, hydrolyzed keratin + hydrolyzed collagen to each strand, with no ammonia. Simply mix equal amounts colorant (#1) + developer (#2) in the provided plastic container, shaking horizontally until the mixture turns to gel and apply!

First, wear gloves before starting the coloring session. Pour an equal amount of #1 (colorant) & #2 (developer) into the provided plastic container and close the cap until you hear the click sound. Mix well by shaking the container horizontally or sideways until the mixture turns to gel. (Do NOT shake the container vertically or up & down). Carefully open the container from the side and scoop the contents on hand to start the procedure. Use appropriate amounts as you color by sections. To apply the gel to the top, sides, and the back, gently rub the gel against hair. With the remaining gel, lightly apply along the hairline to finish the procedure. Wait according to the indicated time for the color to process (20 min. to cover gray hair, 30 min. to change the hair color). After the desired color is obtained, wash and rinse several times with lukewarm water until water runs clear.


NOTE: Leave extra 10 min. if the coloring procedure is done at cool temperature (below room temperature) and/or for thick hair.

description: THE UNIQUE FEATURE OF G&C HAIR COLOR: The exclusive M.A.B. system is what differentiates this product from others on the market. The innovative M.A.B. system enables the product to lighten and deposit pigment simultaneously. The system consists of the following features: MONOETHANOLAMINE This compound stabilizes the pH level of the hair throughout the application process. Balancing the pH level is vital in producing ideal results from a color process. Too much acidity causes the hair to be oily and for the hair shaft to close, making it difficult for color to effectively deposit. Too much alkaline causes the hair to become very dry because the hair shaft becomes very open. A balanced pH level allows for the hair shaft to be open just enough to effectively deposit the color without drying out the hair. AMMONIA Minimal levels (1.8% – 3.5%) of this essential hair color ingredient slightly increases the alkalinity of the formula, ensuring that the hair shaft is sufficiently open to allow the color to fully deposit. BASE Having a base that is both gel and cream creates maximum color coverage while enhancing the luster of pigment. The cream base keeps hair hydrated and ensures maximum conditioning and smoothness as a result from the color process. The gel base reflects light, creating stunning shine and allowing the pigments to stand out in brilliant, eye-catching colors. Balancing the pH level is vital in producing ideal results from a color process. Too much acidity causes the hair to be oily and for the hair shaft to close, making it difficult for color to effectively deposit. Too much alkaline causes the hair to become very dry because the hair shaft becomes very open. A balanced pH level allows for the hair shaft to be open just enough to effectively deposit the color without drying out the hair. description:
▶ Production description

Pudding can do more than what you believe! Now, easy and clear coloring is possible with this groundbreaking, innovative method! Color effortlessly with this hard-to-find pudding-like gel cream by Korean brand EZN that offers vivid coloring + sheen by delivering hydrolyzed silk, hydrolyzed keratin + hydrolyzed collagen to each strand, with no ammonia. Simply mix equal amounts colorant (#1) + developer (#2) in the provided plastic container, shaking horizontally until the mixture turns to gel and apply!


▶ How to use

First, wear gloves before starting the coloring session. Pour an equal amount of #1 (colorant) & #2 (developer) into the provided plastic container and close the cap until you hear the click sound. Mix well by shaking the container horizontally or sideways until the mixture turns to gel. (Do NOT shake the container vertically or up & down). Carefully open the container from the side and scoop the contents on hand to start the procedure. Use appropriate amounts as you color by sections. To apply the gel to the top, sides, and the back, gently rub the gel against hair. With the remaining gel, lightly apply along the hairline to finish the procedure. Wait according to the indicated time for the color to process (20 min. to cover gray hair, 30 min. to change the hair color). After the desired color is obtained, wash and rinse several times with lukewarm water until water runs clear.


NOTE: Leave extra 10 min. if the coloring procedure is done at cool temperature (below room temperature) and/or for thick hair.

최고의 천연 뷰티 어워드에서 수상한 Surya Brazil의 고성능 헤나 파우더는 항산화 성분이 풍부한 반영구적인 헤어 컬러로, 모발에 무성하고 생생한 색상을 주입하며 지속 가능하게 수확된 식물로 영양을 공급합니다. 100% 천연 헤어 컬러, 오래 지속되는 그레이 커버. 성분: Lawsonia Inermis (헤나) 추출물, Phyllanthus emblica (Amla) 추출물, 아카시아 컨시나 추출물, 인디고페라 틴토리아 (인디고) 추출물, 터미날리아 벨레리카 추출물. 헤나: 각 머리카락에 수분을 공급하고 보호층을 형성합니다. 알마: 비타민 C 시카카이가 풍부한 인도 과일: 인도 원산지인 이 단어는 "머리카락을 위한 과일"을 의미하며 모발 성장을 지원하는 우수한 클렌저입니다. 터미날리아 벨레리카: 수렴제 및 살균제 역할을 합니다. 인디고: 컬러링 특성으로 유명합니다. Acacia Concinna: 탄닌이 풍부하여 색상을 고치는 데 도움이 됩니다. Surya 브라질 헤나 파우더는 다음을 포함하지 않습니다. 과산화물, 암모니아, 중금속, 파라벤, PPD, 레조시놀 또는 건강이나 환경에 해를 끼칠 수 있는 기타 성분. 중요: 헤나 크림 및 파우더에 사용되는 천연 성분과 마찬가지로 헤어 컬러 쉐이드의 결과가 달라질 수 있습니다. Surya 브라질 색상은 머리카락을 밝게 하지 않습니다 (머리카락에 손상을 입히기 위해 필요한 가혹한 성분이 포함되어 있지 않습니다)

  • Shampoo as little as possible.
  • Don’t sunbathe.
  • Avoid swimming.
  • Refrain from High Heat Styling.

    • Use gloves when handling the color cream.
    • Keep the hair color vibrant by adding a drop to your conditioner.
    • Sleep on dark-colored pillows because the color can rub off a bit.

title: CREMA COLOR HAIR COLORING CREAM (6/5-Dark Mahogany Blond)
bullet_point: [CREMA COLOR HAIR COLORING CREAM]
description: It is advisable to apply the product on dry and not washed hair. Wear suitable gloves. Preparation: in a metallic bowl mix the necessary quantity of crema colour with the chosen creamy oxidant. Mix well. The choice of creamy oxidant, the results quality depends on the right choice of the creamy oxidant. The choice is made according to the quantity of grey hair, to the natural hair colour and to the desired lightening level. To light to 1 tone use creamy oxidant 20vol. To light to 2-3 tones use creamy oxidant 30vol. To light to 3-4 tones use creamy oxidant 40vol. Instructions: For the colour shades 1 to 10 the mixing ratio is 1+1, 5 shades the mixing ratio is 1+3 (i.e.: 10 gr. of Crema Colour + 30 gr. creamy oxidant). If the percentage of grey is higher than 40% (uniformly distributed) same tone level of the colour shade chosen. Higher is the percentage of grey hair, higher is also the quantity to be mixed of the natural base. Setting Time: For the colour shades 1 to 10: 30 minutes. For the ultrablond (100) shades: 45 minutes. First Application: Using a brush, apply on the lengths and on the tips, starting from 2 cm. from the scalp. Setting time:20 minutes. To give more brightness to the lengths use the creamy oxidant with an higher volume than the one used on the base (i.e.:20 volumes on the base, 30 volumes on the lengths and the tips). In case of the tone on tone coloration, or of darker colorations than the base colour of the hair, apply the colour on the base, on the lengths and on the tips.

Balancing the pH level is vital in producing ideal results from a color process. Too much acidity causes the hair to be oily and for the hair shaft to close, making it difficult for color to effectively deposit. Too much alkaline causes the hair to become very dry because the hair shaft becomes very open. description:

If you care about ethical choices, Crazy Color does too:
Cruelty-free: None of our products have been tested on animals.
Vegan friendly: Our products are free from animal-derived ingredients.

How to use:

  1. Do a patch test. Rule out the possibility of an allergy and make sure you’re happy with the color.
  2. Lighten your hair: For the most vibrant results, use crazy color on pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.
  3. Wash your hair with a PH balanced shampoo. Don't condition your hair.
  4. Apply Crazy Colour dye to your wet hair with a tint brush. Brush the dye from the top of your scalp to the nape of your neck and along each strand of hair. Comb it to make sure it’s evenly coated.
  5. Leave the dye on for 15 - 30 minutes. You can wrap your hair in plastic to keep it warm. Keep it in longer if your hair is thick and resistant to coloring.
  6. Rinse your hair with cool water until the water runs clear.

You did it!

Semi-permanent dyes will lose color intensity after each wash.
Retain your color brightness with these tips.

  • Wash hair with cold water.
  • Shampoo as little as possible.
  • Don’t sunbathe.
  • Avoid swimming.
  • Refrain from High Heat Styling.

    Additional Tips:

    • Use gloves when handling the color cream.
    • Keep the hair color vibrant by adding a drop to your conditioner.
    • Sleep on dark-colored pillows because the color can rub off a bit.

description: Henna is the Arabic name for the Lawsonia Inermis shrub. It reaches a height of 2 to 5 m and grows in the Middle East. The leaves of this shrub are dried and pulverized to make Henna powder. A reddish dye called Henna is extracted from the plant’s dried and pulverized leaves. The plant grows in humid areas of North Africa and South Asia. Henna is very popular with women in Islamic countries and they use it to dye their hair, nails, fingers and feet. An essential oil extracted from its small white-yellowish flowers has been used over the centuries to make perfume. Henna contains the following substances: tannins, flavanoids, triterpens, lipids, sugars and lawsone. Henna has the following properties: astringent, strengthening and sedative. #1 Colorant 2.37 fl.oz (70ml)

#2 Developer 2.37 fl.oz (70ml)

How to use

First, wear gloves before starting the coloring session. Pour an equal amount of #1 (colorant) & #2 (developer) into the provided plastic container and close the cap until you hear the click sound.

Mix well by shaking the container horizontally or sideways until the mixture turns to gel. (Do NOT shake the container vertically or up & down).

Carefully open the container from the side and scoop the contents on hand to start the procedure.

Use appropriate amounts as you color by sections.

To apply the gel to the top, sides, and the back, gently rub the gel against hair. With the remaining gel, lightly apply along the hairline to finish the procedure.

Wait according to the indicated time for the color to process (20 min. to cover gray hair, 30 min. to change the hair color).

After the desired color is obtained, wash and rinse several times with lukewarm water until water runs clear.


NOTE:
Leave extra 10 min. if the coloring procedure is done at cool temperature (below room temperature) and/or for thick hair.

First, wear gloves before starting the coloring session. Pour an equal amount of #1 (colorant) & #2 (developer) into the provided plastic container and close the cap until you hear the click sound.

title: PRAVANA ChromaSilk Creme Hair Color with Silk & Keratin Protein, 7 Blonde
bullet_point: [CREME HAIR COLOR WITH SILK & KERATIN PROTEIN]
description: PRAVANA ChromasSilk CREME HAIR COLOR WITH SILK & KERATIN PROTEIN ChromaSilk is a high-performance Creme hair coloring system that meets the needs of the discriminating professional. ChromaSilk covers completely gray while giving hair unbelievable shine, silkiness, and long lasting color. Pravana's exclusive silk and human hair keratin protein and natural UV filters ensure that hair is actually in better condition after the hair color service. Because of ChromaSilks low ammonia formula it acts as both a permanent and demi-permanent hair color. When used with Pravana 10,20,30,40 volume developers it creates a beautiful long lasting natural looking hair color. When used with Pravana Zero Lift developer ChromasSilk performs as perfect no-lift demi-color. Important Instructions Gray coverage: To fully cover hair that is 50% or more gray, always mix 50% of your color formula with an appropriate level ChromasSilk Creme Color from the natural tone series. ChromaSilk Vivids: These are semi-permanent colors and are applied directly to the hair and should NOT be mixed with any developer. To achieve the vibrant colors displayed in this chart, the hair must be pre-lighened. Super Light Blondes: Super Light Blondes are formulated to be mixed 1 part ChromaSilk color to 2 parts ChromaSilk Creme Developer. However, fewer people know that indigo powder, when used by itself, does not easily bond to or dye one's hair. For best results, indigo requires a 'base' to which to bond. Henna has provides an excellent 'base' for indigo., For deeper black shades it is advisable to color your hair in two steps, first with henna and then with indigo. The amount of time you keep the henna paste in your hair will vary depending on you individual hair structure especially if you have fine or thick hair. After the henna paste has been allowed to set, rinse it off. Now over this pre-henna'd hair you can apply a second, indigo paste, to achieve darker tones., General instructions for use: Step 1- Soak henna powder for 3-4 hours. Add curd or buttermilk if desired. Step 2- Apply henna paste thoroughly (ensure hair is dry and oil free). Allow it to set for 1-4 hours Step 3- Wash hair thoroughly with plain water (do not use shampoo)., Step 4- Mix the desired quantity of indigo powder with water, until the mixture has the consistency of a paste. Add pinch of salt to indigo powder for richer black color. Step 5- Apply indigo paste and cover with a shower cap for 1 to 4 hrs. When finished wash hair with plain water. Do not use shampoo to wash your newly dyed hair. Avoid oiling hair for first two days.]

If you care about ethical choices, Crazy Color does too:
Cruelty-free: None of our products have been tested on animals.
Vegan friendly: Our products are free from animal-derived ingredients.

How to use:

  1. Do a patch test. Rule out the possibility of an allergy and make sure you’re happy with the color.
  2. Lighten your hair: For the most vibrant results, use crazy color on pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.
  3. Wash your hair with a PH balanced shampoo. Don't condition your hair.
  4. Apply Crazy Colour dye to your wet hair with a tint brush. Brush the dye from the top of your scalp to the nape of your neck and along each strand of hair. Comb it to make sure it’s evenly coated.

  6. Rinse your hair with cool water until the water runs clear.

  • Don’t sunbathe.

description:
Green Apple Hair Color - Temporary Hair Dye that Colors Your Hair in Seconds

Temporarily Dye Your Hair Green Apple with Zero Hassle!

Each package comes with detailed instructions on how to use the hair chalks for best and most colorful results.

PVC gloves and cape included with each purchase for simple and mess-free coloring

How to Use the Green Apple Hair Chalk

- Grab a hair chalk, a towel or a plastic cape, gloves, a hair clip, hair spray and trigger bottle with water (or just tap water)
- slightly wet your hair and the end of the hair chalk
- Rub the chalk onto your hair, holding it straight. Rub it in direction of hair growth (from top to bottom) instead of up & down movement. Apply the color with the tip of the hair chalk, not the side, for a brighter and more vivid color.
- You can also try dissolving the hair chalk in a splash of water and applying the mixture on your hair with a hair color brush
- Use the blow dryer to dry your hair - don’t dry it with a towel as the chalk will stain it
- For longer lasting hair chalk, use the hair straightener or hair curler
- For better & longer lasting color, use the hair chalk after you’ve styled your hair!

Powder of Indigo (Indigofera Tinctoria) plant Leaves. Premium quality leaves Ground Triple sifted and carefully packaged in 2 layers of bags.

DIRECTIONS TO COLOR HAIR/BEARD INTO LIGHT BROWN; DARK BROWN; OR BLACK:

P&H INDIGO powder is a natural blue dye. It is used with P&H HENNA powder to obtain these colors.

MAKE PASTE FROM POWDER: HENNA PASTE: Mix 3 or more (up to 15) hours before application to hair. INDIGO POWDER: Mix just before applying; no more 5 to 10 minutes earlier.

TWO STEP METHOD: Recommended for first time use to cover grey or white hair.

  • Ready the paste as above. Apply Henna paste to clean hair Covering the entire length and roots.
  • Cover head with plastic wrap. Wait 90 minutes. Rinse; do not shampoo. This gives an Orange / Red base to hair.
  • Next apply Indigo paste and wrap hair in a shower cap or plastic wrap. Do this immediately or wait up to 24 hours after Henna application. Wait based on your desired hair color

Black 120 minutes; Dark Brown 60 minutes; Light Brown 30 minutes

  • Rinse Do not shampoo for 48 hours while color is developing

ONE STEP METHOD:

  • Ready the paste (See above ‘Make Paste from Powder’). Combine in a third bowl for desired color as follows:

BLACK: 1 Part Henna; 3 Parts Indigo

Balancing the pH level is vital in producing ideal results from a color process. Too much acidity causes the hair to be oily and for the hair shaft to close, making it difficult for color to effectively deposit. Too much alkaline causes the hair to become very dry because the hair shaft becomes very open. A balanced pH level allows for the hair shaft to be open just enough to effectively deposit the color without drying out the hair. The system consists of the following features: MONOETHANOLAMINE This compound stabilizes the pH level of the hair throughout the application process. Balancing the pH level is vital in producing ideal results from a color process. Too much acidity causes the hair to be oily and for the hair shaft to close, making it difficult for color to effectively deposit. Too much alkaline causes the hair to become very dry because the hair shaft becomes very open. A balanced pH level allows for the hair shaft to be open just enough to effectively deposit the color without drying out the hair. AMMONIA Minimal levels (1.8% – 3.5%) of this essential hair color ingredient slightly increases the alkalinity of the formula, ensuring that the hair shaft is sufficiently open to allow the color to fully deposit. BASE Having a base that is both gel and cream creates maximum color coverage while enhancing the luster of pigment. Light Mountain Natural Hair Color and Conditioner Black Description: 100% Premium Henna Henna coats each hair shaft with a natural, semi-permanent protein called hennatannic acid. Heat causes the hennatannic acid to cling to the proteins found in the hair (or nails and skin, if desired). Because henna coats and seals the hair shaft, it helps protect the hair from damaging effects of sun, salt, chlorine, wind and pollution in the environment. It can help miminize split ends and acts as “hair insurance” if you spend a lot of time in the sun, surf or wind. In addition to protecting the hair shaft, henna will tighten the hair cuticle and create a more solid surface which reflects light; the result is gleaming, lustrous hair.

Rather than producing dramatic color changes, henna enhances and deepens existing color. The darker your natural color, the less drastic the change will be inyour natural color. Because the color from henna is transparent or “seethrough,” henna cannot lighten dark hair; it will, however, add highlights to dark hair and can darken the color of lighter hair.

How to use

2. Apply to all areas that need a color boost

3. Slay with your new look

How to choose your colors

Red/Brown/Dark Hair: We recommend Purple, Blue, Gold and Silver colors. The Red color looks like a subdued pink shade on dark hair.

Blonde/Bleached Hair: All colors look great. Silver won't be prominent on bleached hair though.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Does this dry out?

A: Yes - after you apply the Color Wax on your hair, it dries out pretty quickly.

Q: What happens in the rain?

A: While we don't recommend you stay out in heavy rain with or without the hair wax (you know, cause you might catch a cold) - the Color Wax doesn't come off in a mild drizzle. But if you're in the rain long enough - that's pretty much like taking a shower and it will come off.

Q: Does this work on dark hair?

A: The color effect is much more pronounced on lighter hair - and yes, the Color Wax does work on bleached hair as well. The color effect on dark hair is subdued and subtle - but still pretty great.

Q: Will this damage my hair?

A: Based on hundreds of customers' feedback who use the Color Wax several days of the week, combined with the fact that its made out of plant extracts - this will not damage your hair.

Q: Is this safe for kids?

A: Absolutely! In fact, many of our customers buy the Color Wax especially for their kids.

description: In 1972, henna was re-introduced to the consumer with amazing success. AVIGAL HENNA took these shrubs and created a whole new look -- natural, vibrant highlights for every type of hair -- permed, bleached, tinted or virgin. The basic difference between Avigal Henna and other hennas on the market is that Avigal Henna is 100% pure henna made from the finest quality henna available. description:

If you care about ethical choices, Crazy Color does too:
Cruelty-free: None of our products have been tested on animals.
Vegan friendly: Our products are free from animal-derived ingredients.

How to use:

  1. Do a patch test. Rule out the possibility of an allergy and make sure you’re happy with the color.
  2. Lighten your hair: For the most vibrant results, use crazy color on pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.
  3. Wash your hair with a PH balanced shampoo. Don't condition your hair.
  4. Apply Crazy Colour dye to your wet hair with a tint brush. Brush the dye from the top of your scalp to the nape of your neck and along each strand of hair. Comb it to make sure it’s evenly coated.
  5. Leave the dye on for 15 - 30 minutes. You can wrap your hair in plastic to keep it warm. Keep it in longer if your hair is thick and resistant to coloring.
  6. Rinse your hair with cool water until the water runs clear.

You did it!

Semi-permanent dyes will lose color intensity after each wash.
Retain your color brightness with these tips.

  • Wash hair with cold water.
  • Shampoo as little as possible.
  • Don’t sunbathe.
  • Avoid swimming.
  • Refrain from High Heat Styling.

    Additional Tips:

    • Use gloves when handling the color cream.
    • Keep the hair color vibrant by adding a drop to your conditioner.

description:
Now it's colourful. Mix the got2b colour cream for nourishing conditioner and get your very own hair colour. Whether it's bright colours or your own pastel look: mix, apply and have fun.

Full Head Application:
Protect the forehead area and ears with skin cream. Put on gloves and press the colour cream on the palm of your hand. Apply the colour cream to damp hair and work evenly, starting at the back of the head. Cover the pony at the end.

Ombre Application:
Press colour cream into bowl, place aluminium foil strips under the selected hair area, approx. 3-4 cm from the hair end. Use the paint brush to apply the colour cream evenly. Fold the aluminium foil strips so that the hair ends are encased in the foil.

Highlighting Application:
Press colour cream into bowl. Cut 10-15cm aluminium foil strips and start applying at the back of the head. Place aluminium foil strips under each selected strand to close below the hairline. Apply colour cream evenly.

* Paint brush and bowl not included, must not be made of metal and only be used for hair dyeing.



Ahora es colorido. Mezclar la crema de color got2b para nutrir acondicionador y obtener su propio color de cabello. Tanto si se trata de colores brillantes como de tu propio aspecto pastel: mezcla, aplicar y divertirse.

Aplicación de cabeza completa:
Proteja el área de la frente y las orejas con crema para la piel. Ponte guantes y presiona la crema de color en la palma de tu mano. Aplicar la crema de color sobre el cabello húmedo y trabajar uniformemente, comenzando por la parte posterior de la cabeza. Cubra el pony al final.

Ombre Aplicación:
Presione la crema de color en el recipiente, coloque las tiras de aluminio debajo de la zona de pelo seleccionada, aprox. 1.2-1.6 in desde el extremo del cabello. Usa el pincel para aplicar el color crema de manera uniforme. Dobla las tiras de aluminio para que los extremos del cabello estén encerrados en la lámina.

Aplicación destacada:
Presione la crema de color en el tazón. Corta tiras de aluminio de 10 a 5.9 in y empieza a aplicar en la parte posterior de la cabeza. Coloque tiras de aluminio debajo de cada hebra seleccionada para cerrar debajo de la línea del cabello. Aplicar el color crema uniformemente.

* Cepillo de pintura y tazón no incluidos, no deben estar hechos de metal y solo se pueden utilizar para teñir el cabello.

description: Chamomilla recutita An annual herbaceous plant which grows to a height of 15-50 cm and has a strong and recognisable perfume. It has an upright and branched stem with very few leaves. The upper part of the stem has isolated flower heads with an empty, convex receptacle. It has tubular yellow flowers and white ligules. Camomile contains the following substances: azuleno, flavanoids, essential oil, bisabolol, flavones, coumarin, mucilaginous and bitter substances. Camomile has the following properties: antiphlogistic, conditioning, disinfectant, wound healing, sedative, digestive, purifying and anti-inflammatory. Camomile is used in medicine to treat hepatic colic, fever, insomnia, rheumatism, eczema, haemorrhoids and menstrual disorders. At Corpore Sano we use Camomile extract to lighten hair and protect the scalp. We also use it in skin products to cleanse the face, leaving it pure and smooth. Henna is the Arabic name for the Lawsonia Inermis shrub. It reaches a height of 2 to 5 m and grows in the Middle East. The leaves of this shrub are dried and pulverized to make Henna powder. A reddish dye called Henna is extracted from the plant’s dried and pulverized leaves. The plant grows in humid areas of North Africa and South Asia. Henna is very popular with women in Islamic countries and they use it to dye their hair, nails, fingers and feet. An essential oil extracted from its small white-yellowish flowers has been used over the centuries to make perfume. Henna contains the following substances: tannins, flavanoids, triterpens, lipids, sugars and lawsone. Henna has the following properties: astringent, colouring, strengthening and sedative. At Corpore Sano we use Henna extract as a semi-permanent hair dye as it does not damage the hair and leaves it smooth. We also use it to condition and untangle the hair.

description:
Light Mountain Natural Hair Color and Conditioner Black Description: 100% Premium Henna Henna coats each hair shaft with a natural, semi-permanent protein called hennatannic acid. Heat causes the hennatannic acid to cling to the proteins found in the hair (or nails and skin, if desired). Because henna coats and seals the hair shaft, it helps protect the hair from damaging effects of sun, salt, chlorine, wind and pollution in the environment. It can help miminize split ends and acts as “hair insurance” if you spend a lot of time in the sun, surf or wind. In addition to protecting the hair shaft, henna will tighten the hair cuticle and create a more solid surface which reflects light; the result is gleaming, lustrous hair.

Rather than producing dramatic color changes, henna enhances and deepens existing color. The darker your natural color, the less drastic the change will be inyour natural color. Because the color from henna is transparent or “seethrough,” henna cannot lighten dark hair; it will, however, add highlights to dark hair and can darken the color of lighter hair.

There are two ways to process Sparks Colors:

Option 1. For maximum color vibrancy and durability, you must pre-lighten hair with Sparks Powder Lightener and Sparks Creme Developer. To Pre-Lighten, pour contents of the Sparks Powder Lightener packet into a non-metallic bowl. Add 3oz (90ml) of Sparks Creme Developer and mix together until a smooth, creamy consistency is achieved. Apply to desired hair 1/4 inch off the scalp through to the ends. Once completed, go back in and apply lightener to the hair nearest the scalp. Let process until the desired tone is achieved. Shampoo and Rinse thoroughly.

Option 2. Sparks colors may be applied to virgin hair or to hair that has been previously colored but not lightened, however the color will not be nearly as vibrant nor will it last as long in the hair. Before applying Sparks, hair must be freshly shampooed and thoroughly dried. Do not mix Sparks with any developer or peroxide. Apply the desired color directly to hair. Process for 20 minutes at room temperature. Thoroughly shampoo and rinse from the hair until the rinse water runs clear.

description:

Pudding can do more than what you believe! Now, easy and clear coloring is possible with this groundbreaking, innovative method! Simply mix equal amounts colorant (#1) + developer (#2) in the provided plastic container, shaking horizontally until the mixture turns to gel and apply!


▶ How to use

First, wear gloves before starting the coloring session. Pour an equal amount of #1 (colorant) & #2 (developer) into the provided plastic container and close the cap until you hear the click sound. Mix well by shaking the container horizontally or sideways until the mixture turns to gel. (Do NOT shake the container vertically or up & down). To apply the gel to the top, sides, and the back, gently rub the gel against hair. With the remaining gel, lightly apply along the hairline to finish the procedure. Wait according to the indicated time for the color to process (20 min. to cover gray hair, 30 min. to change the hair color). After the desired color is obtained, wash and rinse several times with lukewarm water until water runs clear.


NOTE: Leave extra 10 min. if the coloring procedure is done at cool temperature (below room temperature) and/or for thick hair.

description: In 1972, henna was re-introduced to the consumer with amazing success. What had once been discarded as a primitive hair coloring process was once again a viable force in the beauty field. Fear over chemical side effects as well as a growing interest in healthy products helped to push henna into the limelight again, but the true leader of what became known as the "Henna Revolution" was and still is AVIGAL HENNA. New shrubs of the Lawsonia plant were discovered and developed, which gave life to different colors and shade gradations. AVIGAL HENNA took these shrubs and created a whole new look -- natural, vibrant highlights for every type of hair -- permed, bleached, tinted or virgin. The basic difference between Avigal Henna and other hennas on the market is that Avigal Henna is 100% pure henna made from the finest quality henna available. Avigal Henna is the safest and most effective way to color and condition the hair. Simply add hot water to the henna powder, mix well and apply. Follow the time specified on the enclosed instruction sheet. If you use an external heat source, you can cut the processing time by 30%. PERMED HAIR? You can apply Avigal Henna over permed hair without worry. In fact, Avigal Henna will lock in the perm, making the curl last longer. If you want to perm after a henna application, perm as usual and then reapply henna since the chemicals in the perm will strip the henna color from the hair. GREY HAIR? Avigal Henna has developed 6 shades for single process use on grey hair: Natural, Hazel, Topaz, Champagne, Strawberry Blonde and Red. Each may be applied directly onto grey or graying hair for highlights ranging from extraordinary shine to rich red. Grey hair can also be darkened by the double process method.

Manic Panic originated in 1977 as one of the first products sold at the Bespoke Boutique on St. Mark’s Place in NYC. The vivid shades, tints and hues stemmed from punk rock pioneers Tish and Snooky Bellomo, who transformed the beauty brand into a leading hair color revolution still going strong 40 years later. Tish and Snooky don’t just sell Manic Panic hair dye, they live it as they continue to perform regularly and showcase their vivid hair color on stage with legendary rock and roll acts. The New York native sisters, dubbed as the “Martha Stewarts of Punk Rock” believe in not only sharing colorful hair dye shades but also sharing a portion of their profits by donating 15% of Manic Panic’s annual profits to various charities.

description: The product is a system for complete colour removal for hair dyed with permanent oxidizing hair colour. An advanced formula containing special formula, allows complete colour removal from hair, dyed with permanent hair colour, while preserving the natural pigments of the hair. How does Prestige Color OFF work With oxidizing hair colour the colour is formed by a number of tiny molecules, which bond with one another under the effect of the oxidizer and form giant colour molecules, which form the desired colour. This reaction called oxidation takes place inside the hair and once it finishes, colour molecules become too big and are trapped between the keratin tiles of the hair. That is why such colours are called permanent. This decoloring product is completely different both in its action mechanism and in the results from the well known decoloration products such as bleach powder, lightening emulsions, gels and oil. The above listed products have an oxidizing effect and oxidize colour and destroy them, thus removing the colour. Unfortunately, such products together with the process of oxidizing destroy the hair and to a different degree irritate the scalp, while the colour removal is not always complete. Unlike those products, Prestige Color OFF does not have an oxidizing effect. It has a reducing effect and contains activated reducing molecules. They destroy the big colour molecules and reduce them to smaller ones and as a result they can no longer remain between keratin tiles and can be easily washed.

description:
Get a high-impact color and long-lasting effect with Crazy Color

The Crazy Color Semi-Permanent Renbow Collection comes in 41 vibrant shades and 5 pastel hues. Using this semi-permanent hair dye you get a vibrant color that lasts for 6-8 washes. Our renbow collection is 100% vegan and cruelty-free. All colors are mixable so you can create your custom color. For optimal results apply the dye to pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.

If you care about ethical choices, Crazy Color does too:
Cruelty-free: None of our products have been tested on animals.
Vegan friendly: Our products are free from animal-derived ingredients.

How to use:

  1. Do a patch test. Rule out the possibility of an allergy and make sure you’re happy with the color.
  2. Lighten your hair: For the most vibrant results, use crazy color on pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.
  3. Wash your hair with a PH balanced shampoo. Don't condition your hair.
  4. Apply Crazy Colour dye to your wet hair with a tint brush. Brush the dye from the top of your scalp to the nape of your neck and along each strand of hair. Comb it to make sure it’s evenly coated.
  5. Leave the dye on for 15 - 30 minutes. You can wrap your hair in plastic to keep it warm. Keep it in longer if your hair is thick and resistant to coloring.
  6. Rinse your hair with cool water until the water runs clear.

You did it!

Semi-permanent dyes will lose color intensity after each wash.
Retain your color brightness with these tips.

  • Wash hair with cold water.
  • Shampoo as little as possible.
  • Don’t sunbathe.
  • Avoid swimming.
  • Refrain from High Heat Styling.

    Additional Tips:

    • Use gloves when handling the color cream.
    • Keep the hair color vibrant by adding a drop to your conditioner.
    • Sleep on dark-colored pillows because the color can rub off a bit.

description:
Get a high-impact color and long-lasting effect with Crazy Color

The Crazy Color Semi-Permanent Renbow Collection comes in 41 vibrant shades and 5 pastel hues. Using this semi-permanent hair dye you get a vibrant color that lasts for 6-8 washes. Our renbow collection is 100% vegan and cruelty-free. All colors are mixable so you can create your custom color. For optimal results apply the dye to pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.

If you care about ethical choices, Crazy Color does too:
Cruelty-free: None of our products have been tested on animals.
Vegan friendly: Our products are free from animal-derived ingredients.

How to use:

  1. Do a patch test. Rule out the possibility of an allergy and make sure you’re happy with the color.
  2. Lighten your hair: For the most vibrant results, use crazy color on pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.
  3. Wash your hair with a PH balanced shampoo. Don't condition your hair.
  4. Apply Crazy Colour dye to your wet hair with a tint brush. Brush the dye from the top of your scalp to the nape of your neck and along each strand of hair. Comb it to make sure it’s evenly coated.
  5. Leave the dye on for 15 - 30 minutes. You can wrap your hair in plastic to keep it warm. Keep it in longer if your hair is thick and resistant to coloring.
  6. Rinse your hair with cool water until the water runs clear.

You did it!

Semi-permanent dyes will lose color intensity after each wash.
Retain your color brightness with these tips.

  • Wash hair with cold water.
  • Shampoo as little as possible.
  • Don’t sunbathe.
  • Avoid swimming.
  • Refrain from High Heat Styling.

    Additional Tips:

    • Use gloves when handling the color cream.
    • Keep the hair color vibrant by adding a drop to your conditioner.
    • Sleep on dark-colored pillows because the color can rub off a bit.

description: Preparation instructions : In a large bowl, gradually add warm water to the powders until you have a relatively thick paste. Do not use metal utensils. Before applying to your hair, cover the mixture with plastic film and let sit for one to two hours so the colour can develop. Approximate quantities to be used : For short hair : 50 to 100g of powder For medium-length (shoulder-length) hair : 150 to 200g of powder For long hair (mid-back) : 200 to 250g of powder For very long hair (hip-length) : 300 to 500g of powder How to apply : Apply a thick layer of the mixture preferably to unwashed hair, strand by strand. When hair is thoroughly coated, wrap it all in plastic film and let set. The leave-on time will vary considerably depending on your hair's porosity and colour and the desired result (from one to 12 hours). Rinse hair thoroughly until all residues have been removed. The final colour result will appear two to three days after application, which is the time required for the colour to oxidise. Beauty tip : For fine, sensitised or dry hair, you are advised to add 1 to 2 tablespoons of organic vegetable oil (Castor, Coconut, Argan) or slightly melted Shea butter to your mixture since henna can slightly dry out the hair fibre. We recommend that you use the Centifolia no-rinse lotion with raspberry vinegar which, thanks to its acidity, "closes the hair cuticle" and adds shine. Precautions for use : Do not apply henna or dye powder to hair that has been permed or chemically colour-treated in the last two months. Before colouring your hair, apply a detox mask. Protect areas of your skin likely to be coloured by henna or dye powder by applying a thick layer of a moisturising cream or vegetable oil (top of forehead, ear contour). Wear gloves when preparing and applying the mixture so as to not colour your hands. Do not use metal utensils to mix the henna so as to not alter the quality of the powder.

How to use

First, wear gloves before starting the coloring session. Pour an equal amount of #1 (colorant) & #2 (developer) into the provided plastic container and close the cap until you hear the click sound.

Mix well by shaking the container horizontally or sideways until the mixture turns to gel. (Do NOT shake the container vertically or up & down).

Carefully open the container from the side and scoop the contents on hand to start the procedure.

Use appropriate amounts as you color by sections.

To apply the gel to the top, sides, and the back, gently rub the gel against hair. With the remaining gel, lightly apply along the hairline to finish the procedure.

Wait according to the indicated time for the color to process (20 min. to cover gray hair, 30 min. to change the hair color).

After the desired color is obtained, wash and rinse several times with lukewarm water until water runs clear.


NOTE:

Surya Brazils Hochleistungs-Henna-Pulver ist eine antioxidative reichhaltige semi-permanente Haarfarbe, die das Haar mit üppiger, lebendiger Farbe durchzieht und gleichzeitig mit nachhaltig geernteten Pflanzenstoffen pflegt. 100 % natürliche Haarfarbe mit langanhaltender Grauabdeckung. Zutaten: Lawsonia Inermis (Henna) Extrakt, Phyllanthus emblica (Amla) Extrakt, Akazie Concinna Extrakt, Indigofera Tinctoria (Indigo) Extrakt, Terminalia Belerica Extract. Henna: Spendet Feuchtigkeit und bildet eine Schutzschicht auf jeder Haarsträhne. Alma: Eine indische Frucht reich an Vitamin C Shikakai: Beheimatet in Indien, bedeutet das Wort "Frucht für das Haar" und ist überlegener Reiniger, der das Haarwachstum unterstützt. Terminalia Belerica: fungiert als adstringierendes und bakterizid. Indigo: bekannt für seine Färbeeigenschaften. Akazie Concinna: Reich an Gerbstoffen, hilft die Farbe zu fixieren. Surya Brasilien Henna-Pulver enthält KEIN: Peroxid, Ammoniak, Schwermetalle, Parabene, PPD, Resorcin oder andere Inhaltsstoffe, die der Gesundheit oder der Umwelt schaden. Wichtig: Die Ergebnisse der Haarfarbe variieren ebenso wie die natürlichen Inhaltsstoffe, die in unseren Henna-Cremes und Pudern verwendet werden. Surya Brasilien Farben hellt das Haar nicht auf (Sie enthalten keine aggressiven Inhaltsstoffe, da diese das Haar schädigen).

Henna: Hidrata e forma uma camada protetora em cada fio de cabelo. Surya 巴西的高性能指甲花粉是一种富含抗氧化剂的半永久染发剂,为头发带来郁郁葱葱、鲜艳的色彩,同时可持续收获植物滋养。 100% 天然发色,持久遮盖灰色。 原料:罗素(刺鼻)提取物、印度醋栗(印度醋栗)提取物、金合欢提取物、靛蓝(靛蓝)提取物、贝雷利卡提取物。 指甲花:滋润并形成每根发束的保护层。 Alma:富含维生素C的印度水果:印度本土,意思是"头发的水果",能够促进头发生长。 Terminalia Belerica:可用作收敛剂和杀菌剂。 靛蓝: 以着色特性而闻名。 Acacia Concinna:富含单宁酸,有助于修复颜色。 Surya 巴西指甲花粉不含:过氧化物、氨、重金属、对羟基苯甲酸酯、对苯二胺、间苯二胺或其他可能对健康或环境造成伤害的成分。 重要事项:我们的指甲花乳和粉末中使用的天然成分会有所不同。 Surya 巴西颜色不会淡化头发(不含有害成分,因为这些成分对头发造成伤害)

Surya Brazil 的高性能 Henna Powder 是一種富含抗氧化成分的半永久髮色,為頭髮注入飽滿、鮮豔的顏色,同時以可持續採集的植物滋養。 100% 天然髮色,持久灰色覆蓋。 成分:Lawsonia Inermis (Henna) 萃取物、Phyllanthus emblica (Amla) 萃取物、Acacia Concinna 萃取物、Indigofera Tinctoria(Indigo)萃取物、Terminalia Belerica 萃取物。 Henna: 滋潤並形成保護層。 Alma:富含維他命 C Shikakai 的印度水果:原產於印度,意思是「為頭髮水果」,是促進頭髮生長的優質清潔劑。 Terminalia Belerica:具有收束劑和殺菌的功能。 靛藍:以其著色特性而聞名。 Acacia Concinna:富含單寧,幫助修復顏色。 Surya Brazil Henna 粉不含:過氧化物、氨、重金屬、對羥基苯甲酸酯、PPD、乙醇或其他可能對健康或環境造成傷害的成分。 重要: 染髮效果會與指甲花霜和粉末中使用的天然成分不同。 Surya Brazil 顏色不會使頭髮變淡 (不含必需的刺激成分,因為它們會損壞頭髮)

최고의 천연 뷰티 어워드에서 수상한 Surya Brazil의 고성능 헤나 파우더는 항산화 성분이 풍부한 반영구적인 헤어 컬러로, 모발에 무성하고 생생한 색상을 주입하며 지속 가능하게 수확된 식물로 영양을 공급합니다. 100% 천연 헤어 컬러, 오래 지속되는 그레이 커버. 성분: Lawsonia Inermis (헤나) 추출물, Phyllanthus emblica (Amla) 추출물, 아카시아 컨시나 추출물, 인디고페라 틴토리아 (인디고) 추출물, 터미날리아 벨레리카 추출물. 헤나: 각 머리카락에 수분을 공급하고 보호층을 형성합니다. 알마: 비타민 C 시카카이가 풍부한 인도 과일: 인도 원산지인 이 단어는 "머리카락을 위한 과일"을 의미하며 모발 성장을 지원하는 우수한 클렌저입니다. 터미날리아 벨레리카: 수렴제 및 살균제 역할을 합니다. 인디고: 컬러링 특성으로 유명합니다. Acacia Concinna: 탄닌이 풍부하여 색상을 고치는 데 도움이 됩니다. Surya 브라질 헤나 파우더는 다음을 포함하지 않습니다. 과산화물, 암모니아, 중금속, 파라벤, PPD, 레조시놀 또는 건강이나 환경에 해를 끼칠 수 있는 기타 성분. 중요: 헤나 크림 및 파우더에 사용되는 천연 성분과 마찬가지로 헤어 컬러 쉐이드의 결과가 달라질 수 있습니다. Surya 브라질 색상은 머리카락을 밝게 하지 않습니다 (머리카락에 손상을 입히기 위해 필요한 가혹한 성분이 포함되어 있지 않습니다)

description: Henna is a natural plant coloring for the hair; made from the powdered leaves of a desert shrub plant, Lawsonia. The Henna we offer is 100% natural and organically grown, and is free from pesticide residues, with no synthetic additives or artificial coloring agents. Henna contains hannatannic acid which, when mixed with hot water, will coat the hair. It seals in oils and tightens the hair cuticle giving your hair a rich, healthy shine. Henna has no lightening action, so the shade that you choose will depend on your hair color (natural or tinted) and it must be noted that Henna will not work as a colorant if your hair has more than 10% grey. Its effects will last up to 3 months. Instructions are included with each order. Short fine hair requires: 2-3 oz. Medium length hair: 3-5 oz. Long hair: 5-8 oz. How do I color my hair with henna? Hair Preparation Henna may be applied to wet or dry hair that is clean. Towel dry hair if you wish to shampoo first. Apply cream or oil around the hairline, ears, and neck to avoid staining your skin. Henna Preparation Pour 4oz of Henna into a glass or plastic bowl. Gradually add boiling water. Use a wooden or plastic spoon to mix thoroughly until you have a creamy consistency. More liquid can be added if the mixture is too think. Add 1 egg, 2-4 Tbsp olive oil, or 2-4 Tbsp plain yogurt for dry hair or 2 Tbsp of apple cider vinegar to help gray hair absorb the color. Hair Application Wear plastic or rubber gloves to avoid staining your hands. 1. Separate hair into 1 inch thick sections. 2. Using a brush, begin at the scalp and paint Henna paste onto hair from roots to the ends. 3. Continue applying until all hair is thickly coated with the Henna mixture. 4. Place a cotton or tissue band around the hairline. Cover hair with a plastic wrap. Henna may be applied every 4-6 weeks. The color will blend naturally and fade gradually without noticeable regrowth.

title: CREMA COLOR HAIR COLORING CREAM (100-Natural Ultrablond)
bullet_point: [CREMA COLOR HAIR COLORING CREAM]
description: It is advisable to apply the product on dry and not washed hair. Wear suitable gloves. Preparation: in a metallic bowl mix the necessary quantity of crema colour with the chosen creamy oxidant. Mix well. The choice of creamy oxidant, the results quality depends on the right choice of the creamy oxidant. The choice is made according to the quantity of grey hair, to the natural hair colour and to the desired lightening level. To light to 1 tone use creamy oxidant 20vol. To light to 2-3 tones use creamy oxidant 30vol. To light to 3-4 tones use creamy oxidant 40vol. Instructions: For the colour shades 1 to 10 the mixing ratio is 1+1, 5 shades the mixing ratio is 1+3 (i.e.: 10 gr. of Crema Colour + 30 gr. creamy oxidant). If the percentage of grey is higher than 40% (uniformly distributed) same tone level of the colour shade chosen. Higher is the percentage of grey hair, higher is also the quantity to be mixed of the natural base. Setting Time: For the colour shades 1 to 10: 30 minutes. For the ultrablond (100) shades: 45 minutes. First Application: Using a brush, apply on the lengths and on the tips, starting from 2 cm. from the scalp. Setting time:20 minutes. To give more brightness to the lengths use the creamy oxidant with an higher volume than the one used on the base (i.e.:20 volumes on the base, 30 volumes on the lengths and the tips). In case of the tone on tone coloration, or of darker colorations than the base colour of the hair, apply the colour on the base, on the lengths and on the tips.

The innovative M.A.B. system enables the product to lighten and deposit pigment simultaneously. The system consists of the following features: MONOETHANOLAMINE This compound stabilizes the pH level of the hair throughout the application process. Balancing the pH level is vital in producing ideal results from a color process. Too much acidity causes the hair to be oily and for the hair shaft to close, making it difficult for color to effectively deposit. Too much alkaline causes the hair to become very dry because the hair shaft becomes very open. A balanced pH level allows for the hair shaft to be open just enough to effectively deposit the color without drying out the hair. AMMONIA Minimal levels (1.8% – 3.5%) of this essential hair color ingredient slightly increases the alkalinity of the formula, ensuring that the hair shaft is sufficiently open to allow the color to fully deposit. The minimal levels are not enough to dry out the hair, unlike traditional hair colors that contain higher levels of ammonia. BASE Having a base that is both gel and cream creates maximum color coverage while enhancing the luster of pigment. The cream base keeps hair hydrated and ensures maximum conditioning and smoothness as a result from the color process. The gel base reflects light, creating stunning shine and allowing the pigments to stand out in brilliant, eye-catching colors. How to use:

  1. Do a patch test. Rule out the possibility of an allergy and make sure you’re happy with the color.
  2. Lighten your hair: For the most vibrant results, use crazy color on pre-bleached platinum to medium blonde hair.
  3. Wash your hair with a PH balanced shampoo. Don't condition your hair.
  4. Apply Crazy Colour dye to your wet hair with a tint brush. Brush the dye from the top of your scalp to the nape of your neck and along each strand of hair. Comb it to make sure it’s evenly coated.
  5. Leave the dye on for 15 - 30 minutes. You can wrap your hair in plastic to keep it warm. Keep it in longer if your hair is thick and resistant to coloring.
  6. Rinse your hair with cool water until the water runs clear.

  • Wash hair with cold water.
  • Shampoo as little as possible.
  • Don’t sunbathe.
  • Avoid swimming.
  • Refrain from High Heat Styling.

Q: Does this work on dark hair?

A: The color effect is much more pronounced on lighter hair - and yes, the Color Wax does work on bleached hair as well. The color effect on dark hair is subdued and subtle - but still pretty great.

A: Based on hundreds of customers' feedback who use the Color Wax several days of the week, combined with the fact that its made out of plant extracts - this will not damage your hair.

Q: Is this safe for kids?

Although it is rare, a small number of people may at any time, show an allergic reaction to hair colourants. So always carry out a sensitivity test 48 hours before each and every application. Unscrew caps from developing lotion and hair colourant. Mix one teaspoon of hair colourant with one teaspoon of developing lotion in a glass or plastic bowl.. Recap bottles securely. To preview the colour results and to check the development time, use some of the mixture from your completed sensitivity test. Perms, relaxers and the sun can affect your timing and results. Put on gloves. If using this hair colourant for the first time, apply the colour mixture to the entire strand. If you have previously used hair colour and are checking for shade matching, apply the colour mixture to the new hair growth only. Start timing, after 20 minutes wipe strand clean with a tissue.
